    {
      "name": "ds_top_late_orders",
      "displayName": "Top Late Orders (CM + YTD)",
      "queryLines": [
        "WITH industry_orders AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    item.`Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    item.`Sales Document Item Number`,\n",
        "    item.`Measure Net Value in Euro` AS order_value_eur,\n",
        "    item.`Measure Sales Order Quantity` AS order_qty,\n",
        "    item.`Delivery Date To Key`,\n",
        "    item.`Customer Key`,\n",
        "    item.`Material Key`,\n",
        "    COALESCE(csm.`cs_team`, 'Unmapped') AS cs_team,\n",
        "    item.`Delivery Block` AS delivery_block,\n",
        "    item.`Delivery Block Description` AS delivery_block_desc\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_sales_document_item` item\n",
        "      JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_sales_organization` sorg\n",
        "        ON sorg.`Sales Organization Key` = item.`Sales Organization Key`\n",
        "      LEFT JOIN `supply_chain_sandbox_d`.`datamodel`.`cs_team_sales_org_mapping` csm\n",
        "        ON sorg.`Sales_Organization ID` = csm.`sales_org_code`\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    sorg.`Business Unit 2` = '34'\n",
        "    AND (\n",
        "      item.`Rejection Status` != 'C'\n",
        "      OR item.`Rejection Status` IS NULL\n",
        "    )\n",
        "    AND item.`Order Status` != 'C'\n",
        "    AND (\n",
        "      item.`Sales Document Type Description` IN (\n",
        "        'Standard Order', 'Rush Order', 'Consignment Issue'\n",
        "      )\n",
        "      OR item.`Sales Document Type` IN ('YOR', 'YSO', 'YKE', 'YKB')\n",
        "    )\n",
        "    AND item.`Created On` >= 20260101\n",
        "),\n",
        "-- Pass 1: YTD+ schedule lines only\n",
        "ytd_future_schedule_lines_raw AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    sl.`Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    sl.`Sales Document Item Number`,\n",
        "    TO_DATE(CAST(sl.`Goods Issue Date` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') AS gi_date,\n",
        "    sl.`Measure Confirmed Quantity` AS confirmed_qty,\n",
        "    sl.`Measure Order Quantity` AS sl_order_qty\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_schedule_line` sl\n",
        "      INNER JOIN industry_orders io\n",
        "        ON sl.`Sales Document Number` = io.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND sl.`Sales Document Item Number` = io.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    sl.`Goods Issue Date`\n",
        "      >= CAST(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CURRENT_DATE()), 'yyyyMMdd') AS INT)\n",
        "    AND (sl.`Measure Order Quantity` > 0 OR sl.`Measure Confirmed Quantity` > 0)\n",
        "),\n",
        "ytd_future_schedule_lines AS (\n",
        "  SELECT `Sales Document Number`, `Sales Document Item Number`,\n",
        "    gi_date, confirmed_qty, sl_order_qty\n",
        "  FROM (\n",
        "    SELECT r.*,\n",
        "      MAX(CASE WHEN r.confirmed_qty > 0 AND r.sl_order_qty > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)\n",
        "        OVER (PARTITION BY r.`Sales Document Number`, r.`Sales Document Item Number`) AS has_oq_conf\n",
        "    FROM ytd_future_schedule_lines_raw r\n",
        "  )\n",
        "  WHERE NOT (confirmed_qty > 0 AND sl_order_qty = 0 AND has_oq_conf = 1)\n",
        "),\n",
        "confirmed_items AS (\n",
        "  SELECT DISTINCT\n",
        "    `Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    `Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    ytd_future_schedule_lines\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    confirmed_qty > 0\n",
        "),\n",
        "-- Pass 2: Full history only for confirmed items\n",
        "history_schedule_lines_raw AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    sl.`Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    sl.`Sales Document Item Number`,\n",
        "    TO_DATE(CAST(sl.`Goods Issue Date` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') AS gi_date,\n",
        "    sl.`Measure Confirmed Quantity` AS confirmed_qty,\n",
        "    sl.`Measure Order Quantity` AS sl_oq\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_schedule_line` sl\n",
        "      INNER JOIN confirmed_items ci\n",
        "        ON sl.`Sales Document Number` = ci.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND sl.`Sales Document Item Number` = ci.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    sl.`Goods Issue Date` >= 20260101\n",
        "    AND sl.`Measure Confirmed Quantity` > 0\n",
        "),\n",
        "history_schedule_lines AS (\n",
        "  SELECT `Sales Document Number`, `Sales Document Item Number`, gi_date, confirmed_qty\n",
        "  FROM (\n",
        "    SELECT r.*,\n",
        "      MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl_oq > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)\n",
        "        OVER (PARTITION BY r.`Sales Document Number`, r.`Sales Document Item Number`) AS has_oq\n",
        "    FROM history_schedule_lines_raw r\n",
        "  )\n",
        "  WHERE sl_oq > 0 OR has_oq = 0\n",
        "),\n",
        "item_has_confirmed AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    `Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    `Sales Document Item Number`,\n",
        "    SUM(confirmed_qty) AS total_confirmed_qty\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    history_schedule_lines\n",
        "  GROUP BY\n",
        "    `Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    `Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "),\n",
        "item_unconfirmed_total AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    asl.`Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    asl.`Sales Document Item Number`,\n",
        "    SUM(asl.sl_order_qty) AS total_unconfirmed_order_qty\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    ytd_future_schedule_lines asl\n",
        "      LEFT JOIN confirmed_items ci\n",
        "        ON ci.`Sales Document Number` = asl.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND ci.`Sales Document Item Number` = asl.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    ci.`Sales Document Number` IS NULL\n",
        "    AND asl.sl_order_qty > 0\n",
        "    AND asl.confirmed_qty = 0\n",
        "  GROUP BY\n",
        "    asl.`Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    asl.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "),\n",
        "item_partial_unconfirmed AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    asl.`Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    asl.`Sales Document Item Number`,\n",
        "    SUM(asl.sl_order_qty) AS total_unconfirmed_order_qty\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    ytd_future_schedule_lines asl\n",
        "      INNER JOIN item_has_confirmed ihc\n",
        "        ON ihc.`Sales Document Number` = asl.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND ihc.`Sales Document Item Number` = asl.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "      INNER JOIN industry_orders io\n",
        "        ON io.`Sales Document Number` = asl.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND io.`Sales Document Item Number` = asl.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    asl.sl_order_qty > 0\n",
        "    AND asl.confirmed_qty = 0\n",
        "    AND ihc.total_confirmed_qty < io.order_qty\n",
        "    AND io.order_qty > 0\n",
        "  GROUP BY\n",
        "    asl.`Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    asl.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "),\n",
        "items_with_any_sl AS (\n",
        "  SELECT DISTINCT\n",
        "    `Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    `Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    ytd_future_schedule_lines\n",
        "),\n",
        "date_dim AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    `Date Delivery Key`,\n",
        "    `Date Delivery` AS dim_date\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_date_delivery`\n",
        "),\n",
        "rule1a AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    hsl.gi_date AS delivery_date,\n",
        "    CASE\n",
        "      WHEN ihc.total_confirmed_qty >= o.order_qty OR o.order_qty = 0\n",
        "      THEN o.order_value_eur * (hsl.confirmed_qty / ihc.total_confirmed_qty)\n",
        "      ELSE o.order_value_eur * (hsl.confirmed_qty / GREATEST(o.order_qty, ihc.total_confirmed_qty))\n",
        "    END AS allocated_value,\n",
        "    o.`Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    o.`Sales Document Item Number`,\n",
        "    o.`Customer Key`,\n",
        "    o.`Material Key`,\n",
        "    o.cs_team,\n",
        "    o.delivery_block,\n",
        "    o.delivery_block_desc,\n",
        "    hsl.confirmed_qty AS line_qty,\n",
        "    o.order_qty\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    industry_orders o\n",
        "      JOIN item_has_confirmed ihc\n",
        "        ON ihc.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND ihc.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "      JOIN history_schedule_lines hsl\n",
        "        ON hsl.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND hsl.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    hsl.gi_date >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CURRENT_DATE())\n",
        "),\n",
        "rule1b AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    asl.gi_date AS delivery_date,\n",
        "    o.order_value_eur * (asl.sl_order_qty / iut.total_unconfirmed_order_qty) AS allocated_value,\n",
        "    o.`Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    o.`Sales Document Item Number`,\n",
        "    o.`Customer Key`,\n",
        "    o.`Material Key`,\n",
        "    o.cs_team,\n",
        "    o.delivery_block,\n",
        "    o.delivery_block_desc,\n",
        "    asl.sl_order_qty AS line_qty,\n",
        "    o.order_qty\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    industry_orders o\n",
        "      JOIN item_unconfirmed_total iut\n",
        "        ON iut.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND iut.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "      JOIN ytd_future_schedule_lines asl\n",
        "        ON asl.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND asl.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    asl.confirmed_qty = 0\n",
        "    AND asl.sl_order_qty > 0\n",
        "),\n",
        "rule1b_partial AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    asl.gi_date AS delivery_date,\n",
        "    o.order_value_eur\n",
        "      * (1.0 - LEAST(ihc.total_confirmed_qty / GREATEST(o.order_qty, 1), 1.0))\n",
        "      * (asl.sl_order_qty / ipu.total_unconfirmed_order_qty) AS allocated_value,\n",
        "    o.`Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    o.`Sales Document Item Number`,\n",
        "    o.`Customer Key`,\n",
        "    o.`Material Key`,\n",
        "    o.cs_team,\n",
        "    o.delivery_block,\n",
        "    o.delivery_block_desc,\n",
        "    asl.sl_order_qty AS line_qty,\n",
        "    o.order_qty\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    industry_orders o\n",
        "      JOIN item_has_confirmed ihc\n",
        "        ON ihc.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND ihc.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "      JOIN item_partial_unconfirmed ipu\n",
        "        ON ipu.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND ipu.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "      JOIN ytd_future_schedule_lines asl\n",
        "        ON asl.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND asl.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    asl.confirmed_qty = 0\n",
        "    AND asl.sl_order_qty > 0\n",
        "),\n",
        "rule2 AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    dd.dim_date AS delivery_date,\n",
        "    o.order_value_eur AS allocated_value,\n",
        "    o.`Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    o.`Sales Document Item Number`,\n",
        "    o.`Customer Key`,\n",
        "    o.`Material Key`,\n",
        "    o.cs_team,\n",
        "    o.delivery_block,\n",
        "    o.delivery_block_desc,\n",
        "    o.order_qty AS line_qty,\n",
        "    o.order_qty\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    industry_orders o\n",
        "      LEFT JOIN items_with_any_sl isl\n",
        "        ON isl.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND isl.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "      JOIN date_dim dd\n",
        "        ON dd.`Date Delivery Key` = o.`Delivery Date To Key`\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    isl.`Sales Document Number` IS NULL\n",
        "    AND dd.dim_date >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CURRENT_DATE())\n",
        "),\n",
        "all_alloc AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    *\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    rule1a\n",
        "  UNION ALL\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    *\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    rule1b\n",
        "  UNION ALL\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    *\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    rule1b_partial\n",
        "  UNION ALL\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    *\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    rule2\n",
        "),\n",
        "orders_in_scope AS (\n",
        "  SELECT DISTINCT\n",
        "    `Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    `Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    all_alloc\n",
        "),\n",
        "billing AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    b.`Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    b.`Sales Document Item Number`,\n",
        "    SUM(b.`Billed Quantity`) AS billed_qty\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_billing_document_line_item` b\n",
        "      INNER JOIN orders_in_scope ois\n",
        "        ON ois.`Sales Document Number` = b.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND ois.`Sales Document Item Number` = b.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    b.`Billed Quantity` > 0\n",
        "    AND b.`SD Document Category` = 'M'\n",
        "  GROUP BY\n",
        "    b.`Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    b.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "),\n",
        "delivery_tbl AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    d.`Reference Document` AS `Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    d.`Reference Item` AS `Sales Document Item Number`,\n",
        "    SUM(d.`Measure Actual Delivery Quantity`) AS delivered_qty\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_delivery_item` d\n",
        "      INNER JOIN orders_in_scope ois\n",
        "        ON ois.`Sales Document Number` = d.`Reference Document`\n",
        "        AND ois.`Sales Document Item Number` = d.`Reference Item`\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    d.`Goods Movement Status` = 'C'\n",
        "  GROUP BY\n",
        "    d.`Reference Document`,\n",
        "    d.`Reference Item`\n",
        "),\n",
        "combined AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    a.delivery_date,\n",
        "    a.allocated_value,\n",
        "    a.`Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    a.`Sales Document Item Number`,\n",
        "    a.`Customer Key`,\n",
        "    a.`Material Key`,\n",
        "    a.cs_team,\n",
        "    a.delivery_block,\n",
        "    a.delivery_block_desc,\n",
        "    a.line_qty,\n",
        "    a.order_qty,\n",
        "    GREATEST(COALESCE(d.delivered_qty, 0), COALESCE(b.billed_qty, 0)) AS fulfilled_qty,\n",
        "    SUM(a.line_qty) OVER (\n",
        "        PARTITION BY a.`Sales Document Number`, a.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "        ORDER BY a.delivery_date\n",
        "        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW\n",
        "      ) AS cumul_qty\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    all_alloc a\n",
        "      LEFT JOIN billing b\n",
        "        ON b.`Sales Document Number` = a.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND b.`Sales Document Item Number` = a.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "      LEFT JOIN delivery_tbl d\n",
        "        ON d.`Sales Document Number` = a.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND d.`Sales Document Item Number` = a.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "),\n",
        "with_open AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    *,\n",
        "    CASE\n",
        "      WHEN fulfilled_qty >= order_qty AND order_qty > 0 THEN 0\n",
        "      WHEN\n",
        "        line_qty > 0\n",
        "      THEN\n",
        "        allocated_value\n",
        "          * (\n",
        "            1\n",
        "              - LEAST(\n",
        "                GREATEST(LEAST(fulfilled_qty, cumul_qty) - (cumul_qty - line_qty), 0) / line_qty,\n",
        "                1.0\n",
        "              )\n",
        "          )\n",
        "      ELSE\n",
        "        CASE\n",
        "          WHEN fulfilled_qty > 0 THEN 0\n",
        "          ELSE allocated_value\n",
        "        END\n",
        "    END AS open_value_eur,\n",
        "    CASE\n",
        "      WHEN\n",
        "        delivery_date BETWEEN DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) AND LAST_DAY(CURRENT_DATE())\n",
        "      THEN\n",
        "        'CM'\n",
        "      WHEN\n",
        "        delivery_date >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CURRENT_DATE())\n",
        "        AND delivery_date < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE())\n",
        "      THEN\n",
        "        'YTD'\n",
        "    END AS scope\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    combined\n",
        "),\n",
        "past_due AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    *\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    with_open\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    open_value_eur > 0\n",
        "    AND delivery_date < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1)\n",
        "    AND scope IS NOT NULL\n",
        "),\n",
        "ranked_cm AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    *,\n",
        "    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY open_value_eur DESC) AS rn\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    past_due\n",
        "  WHERE\n",

    {
      "name": "ds_segment_focus",
      "displayName": "Segment Focus - Past Due Orders",
      "queryLines": [
        "WITH industry_orders AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    item.`Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    item.`Sales Document Item Number`,\n",
        "    item.`Measure Net Value in Euro` AS order_value_eur,\n",
        "    item.`Measure Sales Order Quantity` AS order_qty,\n",
        "    item.`Delivery Date To Key`,\n",
        "    item.`Customer Key`,\n",
        "    item.`Material Key`,\n",
        "    COALESCE(item.`Application area Description`, 'Unknown') AS segment,\n",
        "    COALESCE(csm.`cs_team`, 'Unmapped') AS cs_team,\n",
        "    item.`Shipping Conditions Description` AS shipping_condition,\n",
        "    item.`Created By` AS created_by\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_sales_document_item` item\n",
        "      JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_sales_organization` sorg\n",
        "        ON sorg.`Sales Organization Key` = item.`Sales Organization Key`\n",
        "      LEFT JOIN `supply_chain_sandbox_d`.`datamodel`.`cs_team_sales_org_mapping` csm\n",
        "        ON sorg.`Sales_Organization ID` = csm.`sales_org_code`\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    sorg.`Business Unit 2` = '34'\n",
        "    AND (\n",
        "      item.`Rejection Status` != 'C'\n",
        "      OR item.`Rejection Status` IS NULL\n",
        "    )\n",
        "    AND item.`Order Status` != 'C'\n",
        "    AND (\n",
        "      item.`Sales Document Type Description` IN (\n",
        "        'Standard Order', 'Rush Order', 'Consignment Issue'\n",
        "      )\n",
        "      OR item.`Sales Document Type` IN ('YOR', 'YSO', 'YKE', 'YKB')\n",
        "    )\n",
        "    AND item.`Created On` >= 20260101\n",
        "),\n",
        "-- Pass 1: All schedule lines for 2026+ orders via INNER JOIN\n",
        "all_sl_raw AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    sl.`Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    sl.`Sales Document Item Number`,\n",
        "    TO_DATE(CAST(sl.`Goods Issue Date` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') AS gi_date,\n",
        "    sl.`Measure Confirmed Quantity` AS confirmed_qty,\n",
        "    sl.`Measure Order Quantity` AS sl_order_qty\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_schedule_line` sl\n",
        "      INNER JOIN industry_orders io\n",
        "        ON sl.`Sales Document Number` = io.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND sl.`Sales Document Item Number` = io.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    sl.`Goods Issue Date` >= 20260101\n",
        "    AND (sl.`Measure Order Quantity` > 0 OR sl.`Measure Confirmed Quantity` > 0)\n",
        "),\n",
        "all_sl AS (\n",
        "  SELECT `Sales Document Number`, `Sales Document Item Number`,\n",
        "    gi_date, confirmed_qty, sl_order_qty\n",
        "  FROM (\n",
        "    SELECT r.*,\n",
        "      MAX(CASE WHEN r.confirmed_qty > 0 AND r.sl_order_qty > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)\n",
        "        OVER (PARTITION BY r.`Sales Document Number`, r.`Sales Document Item Number`) AS has_oq_conf\n",
        "    FROM all_sl_raw r\n",
        "  )\n",
        "  WHERE NOT (confirmed_qty > 0 AND sl_order_qty = 0 AND has_oq_conf = 1)\n",
        "),\n",
        "-- Items with confirmed lines (need full history for FIFO)\n",
        "confirmed_items AS (\n",
        "  SELECT DISTINCT\n",
        "    `Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    `Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    all_sl\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    confirmed_qty > 0\n",
        "),\n",
        "item_has_confirmed AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    `Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    `Sales Document Item Number`,\n",
        "    SUM(confirmed_qty) AS total_confirmed_qty\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    all_sl\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    confirmed_qty > 0\n",
        "  GROUP BY\n",
        "    `Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    `Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "),\n",
        "item_unconfirmed_total AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    asl.`Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    asl.`Sales Document Item Number`,\n",
        "    SUM(asl.sl_order_qty) AS total_unconfirmed_order_qty\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    all_sl asl\n",
        "      LEFT JOIN confirmed_items ci\n",
        "        ON ci.`Sales Document Number` = asl.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND ci.`Sales Document Item Number` = asl.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    ci.`Sales Document Number` IS NULL\n",
        "    AND asl.sl_order_qty > 0\n",
        "    AND asl.confirmed_qty = 0\n",
        "  GROUP BY\n",
        "    asl.`Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    asl.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "),\n",
        "item_partial_unconfirmed AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    asl.`Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    asl.`Sales Document Item Number`,\n",
        "    SUM(asl.sl_order_qty) AS total_unconfirmed_order_qty\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    all_sl asl\n",
        "      INNER JOIN item_has_confirmed ihc\n",
        "        ON ihc.`Sales Document Number` = asl.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND ihc.`Sales Document Item Number` = asl.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "      INNER JOIN industry_orders io\n",
        "        ON io.`Sales Document Number` = asl.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND io.`Sales Document Item Number` = asl.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    asl.sl_order_qty > 0\n",
        "    AND asl.confirmed_qty = 0\n",
        "    AND ihc.total_confirmed_qty < io.order_qty\n",
        "    AND io.order_qty > 0\n",
        "  GROUP BY\n",
        "    asl.`Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    asl.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "),\n",
        "items_with_any_sl AS (\n",
        "  SELECT DISTINCT\n",
        "    `Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    `Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    all_sl\n",
        "),\n",
        "date_dim AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    `Date Delivery Key`,\n",
        "    `Date Delivery` AS dim_date\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_date_delivery`\n",
        "),\n",
        "rule1a AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    asl.gi_date AS delivery_date,\n",
        "    CASE\n",
        "      WHEN ihc.total_confirmed_qty >= o.order_qty OR o.order_qty = 0\n",
        "      THEN o.order_value_eur * (asl.confirmed_qty / ihc.total_confirmed_qty)\n",
        "      ELSE o.order_value_eur * (asl.confirmed_qty / GREATEST(o.order_qty, ihc.total_confirmed_qty))\n",
        "    END AS allocated_value,\n",
        "    o.`Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    o.`Sales Document Item Number`,\n",
        "    o.`Customer Key`,\n",
        "    o.`Material Key`,\n",
        "    o.segment,\n",
        "    o.cs_team,\n",
        "    o.shipping_condition,\n",
        "    o.created_by,\n",
        "    asl.confirmed_qty AS line_qty,\n",
        "    o.order_qty\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    industry_orders o\n",
        "      JOIN item_has_confirmed ihc\n",
        "        ON ihc.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND ihc.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "      JOIN all_sl asl\n",
        "        ON asl.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND asl.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    asl.confirmed_qty > 0\n",
        "),\n",
        "rule1b AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    asl.gi_date AS delivery_date,\n",
        "    o.order_value_eur * (asl.sl_order_qty / iut.total_unconfirmed_order_qty) AS allocated_value,\n",
        "    o.`Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    o.`Sales Document Item Number`,\n",
        "    o.`Customer Key`,\n",
        "    o.`Material Key`,\n",
        "    o.segment,\n",
        "    o.cs_team,\n",
        "    o.shipping_condition,\n",
        "    o.created_by,\n",
        "    asl.sl_order_qty AS line_qty,\n",
        "    o.order_qty\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    industry_orders o\n",
        "      JOIN item_unconfirmed_total iut\n",
        "        ON iut.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND iut.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "      JOIN all_sl asl\n",
        "        ON asl.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND asl.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    asl.confirmed_qty = 0\n",
        "    AND asl.sl_order_qty > 0\n",
        "),\n",
        "rule1b_partial AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    asl.gi_date AS delivery_date,\n",
        "    o.order_value_eur\n",
        "      * (1.0 - LEAST(ihc.total_confirmed_qty / GREATEST(o.order_qty, 1), 1.0))\n",
        "      * (asl.sl_order_qty / ipu.total_unconfirmed_order_qty) AS allocated_value,\n",
        "    o.`Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    o.`Sales Document Item Number`,\n",
        "    o.`Customer Key`,\n",
        "    o.`Material Key`,\n",
        "    o.segment,\n",
        "    o.cs_team,\n",
        "    o.shipping_condition,\n",
        "    o.created_by,\n",
        "    asl.sl_order_qty AS line_qty,\n",
        "    o.order_qty\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    industry_orders o\n",
        "      JOIN item_has_confirmed ihc\n",
        "        ON ihc.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND ihc.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "      JOIN item_partial_unconfirmed ipu\n",
        "        ON ipu.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND ipu.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "      JOIN all_sl asl\n",
        "        ON asl.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND asl.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    asl.confirmed_qty = 0\n",
        "    AND asl.sl_order_qty > 0\n",
        "),\n",
        "rule2 AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    dd.dim_date AS delivery_date,\n",
        "    o.order_value_eur AS allocated_value,\n",
        "    o.`Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    o.`Sales Document Item Number`,\n",
        "    o.`Customer Key`,\n",
        "    o.`Material Key`,\n",
        "    o.segment,\n",
        "    o.cs_team,\n",
        "    o.shipping_condition,\n",
        "    o.created_by,\n",
        "    o.order_qty AS line_qty,\n",
        "    o.order_qty\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    industry_orders o\n",
        "      LEFT JOIN items_with_any_sl isl\n",
        "        ON isl.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND isl.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "      JOIN date_dim dd\n",
        "        ON dd.`Date Delivery Key` = o.`Delivery Date To Key`\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    isl.`Sales Document Number` IS NULL\n",
        "),\n",
        "all_alloc AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    *\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    rule1a\n",
        "  UNION ALL\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    *\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    rule1b\n",
        "  UNION ALL\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    *\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    rule1b_partial\n",
        "  UNION ALL\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    *\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    rule2\n",
        "),\n",
        "orders_in_scope AS (\n",
        "  SELECT DISTINCT\n",
        "    `Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    `Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    all_alloc\n",
        "),\n",
        "billing AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    b.`Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    b.`Sales Document Item Number`,\n",
        "    SUM(b.`Billed Quantity`) AS billed_qty\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_billing_document_line_item` b\n",
        "      INNER JOIN orders_in_scope ois\n",
        "        ON ois.`Sales Document Number` = b.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND ois.`Sales Document Item Number` = b.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    b.`Billed Quantity` > 0\n",
        "    AND b.`SD Document Category` = 'M'\n",
        "  GROUP BY\n",
        "    b.`Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    b.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "),\n",
        "delivery_tbl AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    d.`Reference Document` AS `Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    d.`Reference Item` AS `Sales Document Item Number`,\n",
        "    SUM(d.`Measure Actual Delivery Quantity`) AS delivered_qty\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_delivery_item` d\n",
        "      INNER JOIN orders_in_scope ois\n",
        "        ON ois.`Sales Document Number` = d.`Reference Document`\n",
        "        AND ois.`Sales Document Item Number` = d.`Reference Item`\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    d.`Goods Movement Status` = 'C'\n",
        "  GROUP BY\n",
        "    d.`Reference Document`,\n",
        "    d.`Reference Item`\n",
        "),\n",
        "combined AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    a.*,\n",
        "    GREATEST(COALESCE(d.delivered_qty, 0), COALESCE(b.billed_qty, 0)) AS fulfilled_qty,\n",
        "    SUM(a.line_qty) OVER (\n",
        "        PARTITION BY a.`Sales Document Number`, a.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "        ORDER BY a.delivery_date\n",
        "        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW\n",
        "      ) AS cumul_qty\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    all_alloc a\n",
        "      LEFT JOIN billing b\n",
        "        ON b.`Sales Document Number` = a.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND b.`Sales Document Item Number` = a.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "      LEFT JOIN delivery_tbl d\n",
        "        ON d.`Sales Document Number` = a.`Sales Document Number`\n",
        "        AND d.`Sales Document Item Number` = a.`Sales Document Item Number`\n",
        "),\n",
        "with_open AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    `Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    `Sales Document Item Number`,\n",
        "    `Customer Key`,\n",
        "    `Material Key`,\n",
        "    segment,\n",
        "    cs_team,\n",
        "    shipping_condition,\n",
        "    created_by,\n",
        "    delivery_date,\n",
        "    CASE\n",
        "      WHEN fulfilled_qty >= order_qty AND order_qty > 0 THEN 0\n",
        "      WHEN\n",
        "        line_qty > 0\n",
        "      THEN\n",
        "        allocated_value\n",
        "          * (\n",
        "            1\n",
        "              - LEAST(\n",
        "                GREATEST(LEAST(fulfilled_qty, cumul_qty) - (cumul_qty - line_qty), 0) / line_qty,\n",
        "                1.0\n",
        "              )\n",
        "          )\n",
        "      ELSE\n",
        "        CASE\n",
        "          WHEN fulfilled_qty > 0 THEN 0\n",
        "          ELSE allocated_value\n",
        "        END\n",
        "    END AS open_value_eur\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    combined\n",
        "),\n",
        "item_agg AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    `Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    `Sales Document Item Number`,\n",
        "    `Customer Key`,\n",
        "    `Material Key`,\n",
        "    segment,\n",
        "    cs_team,\n",
        "    shipping_condition,\n",
        "    created_by,\n",
        "    SUM(open_value_eur) AS total_open_value,\n",
        "    MIN(delivery_date) AS min_open_date\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    with_open\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    open_value_eur > 0\n",
        "  GROUP BY\n",
        "    `Sales Document Number`,\n",
        "    `Sales Document Item Number`,\n",
        "    `Customer Key`,\n",
        "    `Material Key`,\n",
        "    segment,\n",
        "    cs_team,\n",
        "    shipping_condition,\n",
        "    created_by\n",
        "),\n",
        "ranked AS (\n",
        "  SELECT\n",
        "    o.`Sales Document Number` AS order_number,\n",
        "    o.`Sales Document Item Number` AS item_number,\n",
        "    COALESCE(c.`Customer & Text`, CAST(o.`Customer Key` AS STRING)) AS customer,\n",
        "    COALESCE(m.`Material Text`, CAST(o.`Material Key` AS STRING)) AS material,\n",
        "    o.segment,\n",
        "    o.cs_team,\n",
        "    o.shipping_condition,\n",
        "    COALESCE(un.`User Name`, o.created_by) AS created_by,\n",
        "    o.min_open_date AS planned_gi_date,\n",
        "    ROUND(o.total_open_value, 0) AS open_value_eur,\n",
        "    DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), o.min_open_date) AS days_overdue,\n",
        "    CASE\n",
        "      WHEN o.min_open_date >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE()) THEN 'Current Month'\n",
        "      ELSE 'Prior YTD Months'\n",
        "    END AS period,\n",
        "    CASE\n",
        "      WHEN DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), o.min_open_date) <= 7 THEN '1-7 days'\n",
        "      WHEN DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), o.min_open_date) <= 14 THEN '8-14 days'\n",
        "      WHEN DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), o.min_open_date) <= 30 THEN '15-30 days'\n",
        "      ELSE '30+ days'\n",
        "    END AS aging_bucket\n",
        "  FROM\n",
        "    item_agg o\n",
        "      LEFT JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_customer` c\n",
        "        ON c.`Customer Key` = o.`Customer Key`\n",

        "      LEFT JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_users` un\n",
        "        ON un.`User ID` = o.created_by\n",
        "  WHERE\n",
        "    o.min_open_date < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1)\n",
        ")\n",
        "SELECT\n",
        "  *,\n",
        "  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY period ORDER BY open_value_eur DESC) AS rank_in_period\n",
        "FROM ranked\n",
        "ORDER BY\n",
        "  open_value_eur DESC"

      "columns": [
        {
          "displayName": "priority",
          "description": "",
          "expression": "CASE WHEN `open_value_eur` >= 25000 THEN '1 - Critical' WHEN `open_value_eur` >= 10000 THEN '2 - High' WHEN `open_value_eur` >= 2500 THEN '3 - Medium' ELSE '4 - Low' END"
        }
      ]

    {
      "name": "ds_cancellations_trend",
      "displayName": "Cancellations Daily Trend",
      "queryLines": [
        "SELECT\n",
        "  TO_DATE(CAST(o.`Date - Item Creation` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') AS cancel_date,\n",
        "  COALESCE(csm.`cs_team`, 'Unmapped') AS cs_team,\n",
        "  CASE\n",
        "    WHEN o.`Rejection Reason` IN ('01', '10') THEN 'Customer-driven'\n",
        "    WHEN o.`Rejection Reason` = '02' THEN 'Internal error'\n",
        "    WHEN o.`Rejection Reason` IN ('Z6', '12') THEN 'Material change'\n",
        "    WHEN o.`Rejection Reason` IN ('08', '14') THEN 'Logistics'\n",
        "    WHEN o.`Rejection Reason` IN ('04', '05') THEN 'Supply issue'\n",
        "    WHEN o.`Rejection Reason` IN ('03', '06', '11') THEN 'Administrative'\n",
        "    WHEN o.`Rejection Reason` = '09' THEN 'Pricing'\n",
        "    ELSE 'Other'\n",
        "  END AS reason_category,\n",
        "  COUNT(*) AS cancelled_lines,\n",
        "  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(o.`Net Value Euro`, 0)), 0) AS cancelled_value_eur\n",
        "FROM\n",
        "  `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_o2c_-_self_service_-_sales_orders` o\n",
        "    INNER JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_sales_organization` sorg\n",
        "      ON o.`FK Sales Organization` = sorg.`Sales Organization Key`\n",
        "    LEFT JOIN `supply_chain_sandbox_d`.`datamodel`.`cs_team_sales_org_mapping` csm\n",
        "      ON sorg.`Sales_Organization ID` = csm.`sales_org_code`\n",
        "WHERE\n",
        "  sorg.`Business Unit 2` = '34'\n",
        "  AND o.`Document Type` IN ('YOR', 'YSO', 'YKE', 'YKB')\n",
        "  AND o.`Rejection Status` = 'C'\n",
        "  AND TO_DATE(CAST(o.`Date - Item Creation` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd')\n",
        "    >= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), -180)\n",
        "GROUP BY\n",
        "  1,\n",
        "  2,\n",
        "  3\n",
        "ORDER BY\n",
        "  cancel_date"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "ds_cancellations_detail_7d",
      "displayName": "Cancellations Detail",
      "queryLines": [
        "SELECT\n",
        "  o.`Order Number` AS order_id,\n",
        "  o.`Order Item Number` AS item_no,\n",
        "  TO_DATE(CAST(o.`Date - Item Creation` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') AS created_date,\n",
        "  TO_DATE(CAST(o.`Date - Item Changed` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') AS cancelled_date,\n",
        "  COALESCE(c.`Name 1`, CAST(o.`FK Sold to Party` AS STRING)) AS customer,\n",
        "  sorg.`Country key` AS country,\n",
        "  COALESCE(csm.`cs_team`, 'Unmapped') AS cs_team,\n",
        "  CASE\n",
        "    WHEN o.`Rejection Reason` IN ('01', '10') THEN 'Customer-driven'\n",
        "    WHEN o.`Rejection Reason` = '02' THEN 'Internal error'\n",
        "    WHEN o.`Rejection Reason` IN ('Z6', '12') THEN 'Material change'\n",
        "    WHEN o.`Rejection Reason` IN ('08', '14') THEN 'Logistics'\n",
        "    WHEN o.`Rejection Reason` IN ('04', '05') THEN 'Supply issue'\n",
        "    WHEN o.`Rejection Reason` IN ('03', '06', '11') THEN 'Administrative'\n",
        "    WHEN o.`Rejection Reason` = '09' THEN 'Pricing'\n",
        "    ELSE 'Other'\n",
        "  END AS reason_category,\n",
        "  COALESCE(o.`Rejection Reason`, 'Unknown') AS rejection_reason,\n",
        "  COALESCE(ph.`L2 Product Description`, 'Unknown') AS product_group,\n",
        "  COALESCE(m.`Material Text`, CAST(o.`FK Material` AS STRING)) AS material,\n",
        "  COALESCE(item.`Application area Description`, 'Unknown') AS segment,\n",
        "  ROUND(COALESCE(o.`Net Value Euro`, 0), 0) AS value_eur,\n",
        "  DATEDIFF(\n",
        "    TO_DATE(CAST(o.`Date - Item Changed` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd'),\n",
        "    TO_DATE(CAST(o.`Date - Item Creation` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd')\n",
        "  ) AS days_to_cancel\n",
        "FROM\n",
        "  `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_o2c_-_self_service_-_sales_orders` o\n",
        "    INNER JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_sales_organization` sorg\n",
        "      ON o.`FK Sales Organization` = sorg.`Sales Organization Key`\n",
        "    LEFT JOIN `supply_chain_sandbox_d`.`datamodel`.`cs_team_sales_org_mapping` csm\n",
        "      ON sorg.`Sales_Organization ID` = csm.`sales_org_code`\n",
        "    LEFT JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_customer` c\n",
        "      ON c.`Customer Key` = o.`FK Sold to Party`\n",
        "    LEFT JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_material` m\n",
        "      ON o.`FK Material` = m.`Material Key`\n",
        "    LEFT JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_dim_product_hierarchy` ph\n",
        "      ON ph.`Material Code` = m.`Material Code`\n",
        "    LEFT JOIN `synapse-prd`.pbi.`dbx_fact_sales_distribution_sales_document_item` item\n",
        "      ON item.`Sales Document Number` = o.`Order Number`\n",
        "      AND item.`Sales Document Item Number` = o.`Order Item Number`\n",
        "WHERE\n",
        "  sorg.`Business Unit 2` = '34'\n",
        "  AND o.`Document Type` IN ('YOR', 'YSO', 'YKE', 'YKB')\n",
        "  AND o.`Rejection Status` = 'C'\n",

        "  AND (:cancel_date.max IS NULL OR TO_DATE(CAST(o.`Date - Item Changed` AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') <= :cancel_date.max)\n",
        "ORDER BY\n",

    {
      "name": "allocation_logic",
      "displayName": "Allocation Logic",
      "layout": [
        {
          "widget": {
            "name": "doc_header",
            "multilineTextboxSpec": {
              "lines": [
                "## Industry Division — Open Orders Allocation Logic\n",
                "This page explains how the dashboard calculates order values and assigns them to time buckets (Current Month, Year-to-Date, Future), and how we determine whether an order line is \"open\", \"delivered\", or \"billed\"."
              ]
            }
          },
          "position": {
            "x": 0,
            "y": 0,
            "width": 12,
            "height": 2
          }
        },
        {
          "widget": {
            "name": "doc_orders_included",
            "multilineTextboxSpec": {
              "lines": [
                "**1. Which orders are included?**\n",
                "\n",
                "We include sales orders from the **Industry Division** (Business Unit 34) that meet all of these criteria:\n",
                "\n",
                "* **Document types:** Standard Order, Rush Order, Consignment Issue, or SAP types YOR, YSO, YKE, YKB\n",
                "* **Not rejected:** The order line has not been fully rejected (Rejection Status ≠ C)\n",
                "* **Has a delivery date in the current year or later**"
              ]
            }
          },
          "position": {
            "x": 0,
            "y": 2,
            "width": 12,
            "height": 3
          }
        },
        {
          "widget": {
            "name": "doc_time_split",
            "multilineTextboxSpec": {
              "lines": [
                "**2. How is the order value split across time periods?**\n",
                "\n",
                "A single order line can have multiple **schedule lines** in SAP — each representing a planned delivery batch with its own date and quantity. We use these schedule lines to split the total order value across time periods.\n",
                "\n",
                "| Period | Definition |\n",
                "| --- | --- |\n",
                "| **Current Month (CM)** | Planned goods issue date falls within the current calendar month |\n",
                "| **Year-to-Date (YTD)** | Planned goods issue date is in the current year but before the current month |\n",
                "| **Future (FUT)** | Planned goods issue date is after the current month |\n",
                "\n",
                "The allocation follows a **4-rule hierarchy** based on the schedule line confirmation status of each order item:\n",
                "\n",
                "| Rule | When it applies | How value is split |\n",
                "| --- | --- | --- |\n",
                "| **Rule 1a — Confirmed SLs** | The item has schedule lines with confirmed quantities (confirmed_qty > 0) | Value is split proportionally by confirmed quantity across all confirmed SLs. Uses full 24-month history for FIFO delivery matching. If total confirmed ≥ order qty, confirmed SLs get 100% of value; otherwise value is capped at confirmed share. |\n",
                "| **Rule 1b — Partial (unconfirmed SLs on partially-confirmed items)** | The item has BOTH confirmed AND unconfirmed SLs, and total confirmed qty < order qty | The *remaining* value (order value × (1 − confirmed share)) is split proportionally across unconfirmed SLs by their order quantity. This prevents partially-confirmed items from falling through the cracks. |\n",
                "| **Rule 1b — Full (unconfirmed SLs on fully-unconfirmed items)** | The item has schedule lines but NONE are confirmed (only order quantities, confirmed_qty = 0) | Full order value is split proportionally by schedule line order quantity |\n",
                "| **Rule 2 — No SLs** | The item has no schedule lines at all | The full value is assigned to the period matching the item-level requested delivery date |\n",
                "\n",
                "**Why 4 rules instead of 3?** Previously, Rule 1b only covered items with *zero* confirmed SLs. Items that were partially confirmed (e.g. July SL confirmed, September SL unconfirmed) had their unconfirmed portion dropped entirely — understating open order value. The new Rule 1b Partial captures this remainder."
              ]
            }
          },
          "position": {
            "x": 0,
            "y": 5,
            "width": 12,
            "height": 11
          }
        },
        {
          "widget": {
            "name": "doc_delivery_status",
            "multilineTextboxSpec": {
              "lines": [
                "**3. How do we determine delivery status?**\n",
                "\n",
                "| Bucket | Meaning |\n",
                "| --- | --- |\n",
                "| **Billed** | The customer has been invoiced for this portion |\n",
                "| **Delivered (not billed)** | Goods have left the warehouse but no invoice yet |\n",
                "| **Open Past Due** | Not yet delivered AND the planned date is in the past |\n",
                "| **Open Not Yet Due** | Not yet delivered AND the planned date is today or in the future |\n",
                "\n",
                "**FIFO delivery allocation (First In, First Out)**\n",
                "\n",
                "SAP records deliveries at the order line level but does not tell us which specific schedule line those pieces belong to. We use a **FIFO assumption**: deliveries are matched to schedule lines in date order, earliest first.\n",
                "\n",
                "*Example — Order 0015247609, Line 20:*\n",
                "\n",
                "| Schedule line | Planned date | Confirmed qty |\n",
                "| --- | --- | --- |\n",
                "| 1 | 03.07.2026 | 650 |\n",
                "| 2 | 21.08.2026 | 390 |\n",
                "\n",
                "Total delivered: 650. FIFO consumes earliest first → July line fully delivered (650/650), August line still open (0/390)."
              ]
            }
          },
          "position": {
            "x": 0,
            "y": 16,
            "width": 12,
            "height": 9
          }
        },
        {
          "widget": {
            "name": "doc_kpis",
            "multilineTextboxSpec": {
              "lines": [
                "**4. KPI Formulas**\n",
                "\n",
                "| KPI | Formula |\n",
                "| --- | --- |\n",
                "| **CM Total** | Sum of all allocated value where scope = Current Month |\n",
                "| **CM Billed + Delivered** | Sum of Billed and Delivered (not billed) value for Current Month |\n",
                "| **CM Open Past Due** | Sum of Open Past Due value for Current Month only |\n",
                "| **YTD Open Past Due** | Sum of Open Past Due value for Year-to-Date scope only |\n",
                "| **Billed + Delivered %** | (Billed + Delivered) / CM Total |"
              ]
            }
          },
          "position": {
            "x": 0,
            "y": 25,
            "width": 6,
            "height": 6
          }
        },
        {
          "widget": {
            "name": "doc_run_rate",
            "multilineTextboxSpec": {
              "lines": [
                "**6. Run rate status**\n",
                "\n",
                "For each CS team, we compare delivery progress against the calendar:\n",
                "\n",
                "* **Month progress** = Working days elapsed / Total working days in the month\n",
                "* **Delivery progress** = (Billed + Delivered value) / Total allocated CM value\n",
                "\n",
                "| Status | Condition |\n",
                "| --- | --- |\n",
                "| 🟢 On Track | Delivery progress within 5% of month progress |\n",
                "| 🟠 Behind | 5–25% below month progress |\n",
                "| 🔴 Significantly Behind | More than 25% below |"
              ]
            }
          },
          "position": {
            "x": 6,
            "y": 25,
            "width": 6,
            "height": 6
          }
        },
        {
          "widget": {
            "name": "doc_cs_teams",
            "multilineTextboxSpec": {
              "lines": [
                "**5. CS Team assignment**\n",
                "\n",
                "Each order is assigned to a Customer Service team based on the sales organization: **Europe**, **US**, **Asia**, **Skamol**, **FSi**. The mapping is maintained in the `cs_team_sales_org_mapping` table."
              ]
            }
          },
          "position": {
            "x": 0,
            "y": 31,
            "width": 6,
            "height": 3
          }
        },
        {
          "widget": {
            "name": "doc_assumptions",
            "multilineTextboxSpec": {
              "lines": [
                "**7. Key assumptions and changelog**\n",
                "\n",
                "1. **FIFO is an assumption** — SAP does not provide schedule-line-level delivery data\n",
                "2. **Billing and delivery are at item level** — we cannot distinguish which invoice belongs to which schedule line\n",
                "3. **Working days** exclude weekends (Sat/Sun) but not public holidays\n",
                "4. **Confirmed SL history** uses a 24-month lookback window to ensure accurate FIFO allocation for long-running orders\n",
                "5. **Partially-confirmed items** — both the confirmed and unconfirmed portions are allocated (neither is dropped)\n",
                "\n",
                "**Changelog**\n",
                "\n",
                "| Date | Change |\n",
                "| --- | --- |\n",
                "| 04 Sep 2026 | Added Rule 1b Partial for partially-confirmed items; applied consistently across all 5 allocation datasets (overview, run rate, all open orders, top late orders, segment focus) |\n",
                "| 29 Jul 2026 | Initial allocation logic documentation |"
              ]
            }
          },
          "position": {
            "x": 6,
            "y": 31,
            "width": 6,
            "height": 5
          }
        }
